description: Clockwise 360-degree camera orbit around a frozen subject from 1-4 reference photos. Use the structured Ref2VA prompts in the repo's prompts/*.txt verbatim - their timestamps assume 124 frames; about 20 steps. Trained on the adaln-pruned base but carries no adaln keys, so it loads on the full one; quality there is unproven. The repo's cardspin_v2 file (trigger ORB360_CARDSPIN) spins the photo like a card instead
use_when: Orbit the camera all the way round a subject from reference photos
